newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian money markets liquid with bond leftovers.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian money markets liquid with bond leftovers.

text.p: Egyptian overnight interbank rates slipped in a private sector market flush with funds left over from the Central Bank's bond offer to 10 1/4 percent on Tuesday from Monday's range of 10 3/8 and 10 1/2 percent.
One week rates bank rates were also lower at 10 1/4 percent, from the 10 3/8 percent and 10 1/2 percent range.
The central bank offered seven-year bonds worth four billion pounds and received applications for bonds worth 10.119 billion. The bonds carry a fixed interest rate of 11 percent.
